description: Blind proxy removes the target from x402 facilitator metadata; HirePulse and the destination still see it. Arguments are tool and target only. $0.02 single check; $0.04 company_profile/due_diligence bundle via X-Private-Query-Tier or MCP metadata hirepulse/private-tier. Direct tools suit non-private lookups.

target.description: Bare public domain for company tools, or a public HTTP(S) URL for clean_markdown; excluded from facilitator metadata, but visible to HirePulse and the destination.

tool.description: Lookup to execute. company_profile and due_diligence require the bundle tier selected in the HTTP header or MCP request metadata.

name: private_blind_lookup
title: Private Blind Lookup
